notes.title: Version 1.1 is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Version 1.1 is a complete overhaul of the game! This update includes:

[list]
[*] Fully new art style
[*] Rebalanced Combat
[*] The Seasam Village - A village of nomadic lion people, the village moves around the Plains region constantly
[*] The Seasam Torunament - In the Seasam village you can fight dreadful beasts to claim the Seasam Cups!
[*] General quality of life and bug fixes
[/list]

Viridian Sage is better than ever! 
Every spell tells a story, what will yours be?
